checks.name: scope-boundary
checks.summary: Scope boundary for V2-082, recorded against base commit 9a09ef867a582237252721916a3d915225d2107d. ROW 1 -- what this task makes true: a Requirement captured through the real HTTP surface can be driven out of the captured status by one new caller-initiated application command, Service.StartFraming, reached over POST /v1/requirements/{requirement_id}:start-framing, so the status from which a person can be asked a question is reachable for the first time. The set of Requirement statuses reachable through every application command goes from the single element {captured} to exactly {captured, framing, needs-input, ready}. ROW 2 -- what it deliberately does not do: internal/domain is byte-unchanged (the transition, its guard and its target status already existed); no read model changed; no owner-console control was added and internal/web/** and docs/** are untouched; no port, no stored field, no document kind and no index was added; Capture does not advance on its own and CaptureRequest gained no flag, so `captured` stays observable and CaptureResponse.Version stays 1; and no reconciler or scheduler sweep walks captured Requirements. ROW 3 -- what it records but does not fix: Plan and Prepare evaluate NO domain.Permit and therefore move canonical Increment and Requirement state under emergency-stop and under every other stop mode (measured, see the plan-and-prepare-are-permit-free check); internal/application/service.go is prohibited here, so that is escalated rather than changed, and its permit-free shape was deliberately NOT propagated to the new command. ROW 4 -- what only a later task can establish: the full chain against a real Provider-gated dogfood is NOT executed here, so the rewritten dogfood helper is compiled and go vet clean but recorded skipped and the api record's result is partial; the M5 re-dogfood is a required, coordinator-owned follow-up. The six other unissued domain Requirement commands (start, wait, recover, evaluate, pause, cancel) and domain.CompleteRequirementFromRelease stay unissued by design. ROW 5 -- this task passes no release gate on its own: no release_eligible entry is produced, no capability id is cited in any of these three records, contracts/release-contract/** is untouched and .agents/v2/evidence/V2-022-release-live-dogfood.json is untouched.
